content.text: No restriction binds AbbVie; the only exclusivity covenant runs against Harpoon in our favour.

input.quote: 5.8.1 Harpoon shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to (a) directly or indirectly, develop, commercialize or otherwise exploit any Competing Product in any country or other jurisdiction in the Territory
input.rationale: The only non-compete/field-of-use covenant in the Agreement is Section 5.8 ("Exclusivity with Respect to the Territory"), and it binds Harpoon (the counterparty) and its Affiliates only — it prohibits Harpoon from developing, commercializing or enabling Third Parties to exploit any Competing Product in the Territory. That restriction runs in our favour and is not flagged. Section 5.8.2's Acquisition/Change-in-Control carve-outs likewise operate on Harpoon and expressly give AbbVie discretionary rights (Segregation of the Competing Product, ability to cut off Confidential Information flow and disband the JGC), so they benefit us. Searches for restrictions binding AbbVie ("AbbVie shall not", "Competing Product", "directly or indirectly, develop", "compete") return no field-of-use, territory or competing-product restraint on AbbVie; the AbbVie covenants in Section 10.4 are limited to obtaining IP rights from its Affiliates, Sublicensees and personnel. This meets the preferred position: no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on the Customer.
